methodology.input_corpus: 11 shared PQ fixtures; one validated fixed ECDSA input, previously checked against a 32-input diagnostic corpus
methodology.leanvm_boundary: Unmodified public native verify with parsed key/signature; parsing excluded
methodology.ecrecover_boundary: Actual evm2 provider including signature parsing, key recovery, serialization and address hashing; provider initialized outside timing
methodology.our_boundary: Public lean-sphincs verify consuming signature bytes
methodology.upstream_hash_backend: leanVM own Keccak, native AVX-512 single-state permutation in both configurations; Alloy asm-keccak feature does not switch it
methodology.operations: 7 kernels interleaved in randomized order per round; verify/ecrecover are the reporting focus
methodology.samples: 44 batch samples per operation in each of 3 fresh processes per configuration; pooled median of all 132 samples
methodology.affinity: CPU 8, verified before releasing wait-for-start handshake
methodology.priority: AboveNormal, verified before releasing wait-for-start handshake
methodology.gas: Local runtime calibration only; excludes transaction/data costs, dispatch, malformed/adversarial workloads and aggregation/proving

session.launcher: Windows subprocess, wait-for-start handshake after setting and checking affinity/priority

report.methodology: Single-threaded; randomized interleaving of kernels within each sampling round. Fixture generation, cross-checks, warmup, calibration and checkpoint I/O excluded. Samples are batch averages, not individual-call latency. Raw outliers retained. Signature operations recompute from the seed. Wire APIs include decoding/serialization; parsed verification excludes decoding. Hash batch results are normalized per input. CPU-time ratios do not establish protocol gas costs.
